Immanuel Lutheran Church (DeLamere, N.D.)
spatial: United States; North Dakota; Sargent County (N.D.);
description: The second edition cookbook of the Immanuel Lutheran Church near DeLamere, North Dakota. The contents include: bread and rolls; cakes, frosting, and fillings; candy, beverages, and miscellaneous; cookies, bars, and doughnuts; pies and desserts; meats, casseroles, and soup; pickles and preserves; salad and dressing; Scandinavian delicacies.
